title: getorderswithitemsforoutlet
description: Test GET /rest/v1/orders with a valid Bearer token to verify successful retrieval of orders including nested order items and menu item details, ensuring correct display of order list for the outlet.

title: updateorderstatus
description: Test PATCH /rest/v1/orders with a valid Bearer token and valid order status update payload to confirm order status changes correctly and response is 204 No Content or updated order representation.

title: fetchaggregatedrevenuesummary
description: Test POST /rest/v1/rpc/pos_revenue_summary_guarded with valid Bearer token and outlet parameters to verify correct aggregated revenue summary is returned and rendered.

title: fetchvalidpromos
description: Test GET /rest/v1/promos with a valid Bearer token to ensure active promotions are retrieved and displayed correctly.

title: websocketconnectionforrealtimeorderupdates
description: Test WebSocket connection to /realtime/v1/websocket with valid authenticated Supabase credentials to verify successful connection, subscription to public:orders, and real-time receipt of incoming order events.

title: approvebypassrequest
description: Test POST /api/bypass/approve?id={id} with a valid Bearer token and valid id to confirm bypass approval is successful and gate request proceeds as approved.

title: fetchkioskaccounts
description: Test GET /api/kasir/kiosk-accounts with a valid Bearer token to verify retrieval and display of the outlet's kiosk account list.

title: generateqrforkiosk
description: Test POST /api/kasir/generate-kiosk-qr with a valid Bearer token and valid kiosk request payload to ensure QR code data is generated and presented correctly.
